about_the_game:
Full Moon Fishing is a short and sweet immersive experience. You find yourself in a calm nighttime glade surrounded by fireflies, with otherworldly stars filling the sky above. A camper from out of this world is the only company you have. Jumping into the well reveals a whole new world to explore, but before long you find yourself right back where you started.

Equipped with a flashlight, a spear, and some boots, explore the world and catch the many fish below. Sell your catch to the astronaut to earn some money, upgrade your gear, and return to the well to continue fishing! As your gear improves, new fish will begin appearing in the well. What bizarre fish will you discover, and what secrets will you find?

Critical Game Information

A playthrough is approximately 90 minutes long 

Keybindings cannot be adjusted

AspectRatios larger than 16:9 may experience unintended visuals

There is a definitive conclusion

short_description: Full Moon Fishing is a casual immersive spear fishing game. Catch fish and upgrade your gear while you explore the strange and beautiful world that seems to loop back on itself endlessly. Will you discover what's behind the door?
